title: plugin-dashboard: `ObjectMetricWidgetProps` still declares the RETIRED `{ key, defaultValue }` label form — a TS consumer writing the declared shape renders the raw dotted i18n key as the visible label
body:
Found while implementing #4032 item 4 (PR #5262). Not fixed there — different file, different defect class, filed rather than ridden along.

## What

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectMetricWidget.tsx` declares the key-reference label form on four members:

```
48:  label: string | { key?: string; defaultValue?: string };
54:    label?: string | { key?: string; defaultValue?: string };   // trend.label
62:  description?: string | { key?: string; defaultValue?: string };
89:  title?: string | { key?: string; defaultValue?: string };     // drill-down panel title
```

That vocabulary was RETIRED by the spec in rc.6 (objectstack#5055). PR #4358 migrated the sibling `MetricWidgetProps` to `string | I18nLabel` for exactly this reason, and its own doc comment says so — "It is not accepted here any more because the spec rejects it at authoring time". `ObjectMetricWidgetProps` was not migrated in the same pass. These four are the only remaining declarations of the shape in `packages/*/src` (grepped, excluding tests).

## Why it is not merely inert

`ObjectMetricWidget` forwards `label` / `description` / `trend` straight to `MetricWidget`, which resolves them with `pickLocalized`. Handed the retired shape, `pickLocalized` misses every locale limb and falls through to its last resort — `Object.values(o).find(v =` typeof string) — which returns the FIRST string property in insertion order. Measured against `packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts` on this tree:

```
pickLocalized({ key: 'crm.dashboards.sales.widgets.revenue.title', defaultValue: 'Total Revenue' }, 'zh')
  -> "crm.dashboards.sales.widgets.revenue.title"      // key written first
pickLocalized({ defaultValue: 'Total Revenue', key: 'crm.dashboards.sales.widgets.revenue.title' }, 'zh')
  -> "Total Revenue"                                   // defaultValue written first
```

So a TypeScript consumer who writes the shape the interface still invites — in the natural `{ key, defaultValue }` order, which is how the retired form was always spelled — gets the raw dotted translation key painted into the KPI card as its visible label. The outcome depends on property order, which is why it would not read as a systematic bug in review.

The type is what makes this reachable: this is a public exported props interface, so the declaration is an invitation, and the runtime neither resolves the key nor rejects the object.

## Suggested shape

Migrate the four members to `string | I18nLabel`, matching `MetricWidgetProps`. Worth checking in the same pass whether any call site or fixture in the repo still constructs the retired form (the #4032 fixture triage discipline: a fixture pinning the retired branch keeps passing precisely because nothing is produced any more).

## Scope note

Deliberately NOT bundled into PR #5262. That PR is #4032 item 4 — the sub-caption's convention key — and it neither reads nor writes these declarations; folding an unrelated public-type migration into it would have widened its verification surface without evidence in its own tests.
